name: suno_strings_choir
prompt: instrumental, no lyrics. Solemn but tender cinematic fairy-tale: low cello pedal enters quietly, viola pulse joins, violin melody rises; then a wordless children's choir humming ah enters on top, full strings lifting toward a warm mf peak, as if carrying someone up a stairway of stars toward the moon. After the peak the choir recedes first, strings thin out, ending in near-silence. Clear dynamic arc p to mf to pp. No drums, no percussion.
